facts.fact: Daily Monitor reports the Computer Misuse Act provides the offence of malicious information, with a fine option, under which the Nakawa court sentenced a student.

Daily Monitor reports Nakawa Chief Magistrate's Court sentenced student Edison Ssemugenyi to six months in prison after he pleaded guilty to two counts of malicious information under the Computer Misuse Act.

Daily Monitor reports a student was jailed six months for TikTok posts alleging President Museveni was ill and Gen. Muhoozi was homosexual, and faces a further hate speech charge for calling the President a thief.
